results.title: Batch of 2025-26 Results
results.body:
Lawrence High School ICSE congratulates the Batch of 2025-26 on a 100% result.

Distinctions (85% and above): 85 students.
58 students scored above 90, 27 students scored 85–89%, 15 students scored 80–84%, and 29 students scored 60–80%.
